title: app-shell: the Related-tab drawer edits an embedded validation rule as raw JSON with no form and no lint — the real fix is a served validation schema AND a `WidgetContext` landed as ONE change (objectui#9791 ruling C, deferred until an author hits it)
body:
Filed by the director seat (objectstack #12708, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`) executing decision batch #160 item 5 — maintainer 「同意」 to **C** on objectui#9791: that card closes as 「finding correct, named remedy inert」; this card carries the real defect and the hard constraint so nothing lives only on a closed card.

## The defect (measured by the `domain:ui#2` seat, objectui#9791 comment 5727060544)

`EmbeddedItemEditor` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`) serves three `editAs` tiers and renders **no condition field on any of them**: `validation` — the standalone kind is retired (ADR-0088), `/meta/types` publishes no schema and `FALLBACK_SCHEMAS` has no row, so the drawer falls to the **raw-JSON textarea**; `field` — the served derivation of `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` has no string arm, so `detectConditionWidget` never fires; `index` — no predicate-named key. An author editing an embedded validation rule through the Related tab gets neither the condition builder nor any lint, on a surface whose runtime **fail-closes** on an unevaluable predicate.

## ⛔ The constraint that must survive

**The schema half landed alone re-creates objectui#8167's defect at this host**: the moment a validation schema with a string `condition` key is served, the name-convention route mounts the builder, and with no `WidgetContext` `celAuthoring`'s `hint.scope ?? 'flattened'` answers on a surface objectql binds as the `record` root — a loud false green. ⇒ the served schema and the `WidgetContext` (with the ruled `conditionScope` for this host) are **one change, in either order, whoever does it**. Measured coupling, not a preference.

## Why it is p3 and queued rather than dispatched now

Zero measured pull: no author has been observed using this drawer for validation rules (they author files). The maintainer's standing order for a zero-pull capability widening is not to build it yet. Re-trigger: a named author (object + metadata) hitting the raw-JSON path for a validation rule ⇒ re-grade p2 and dispatch.

## Refs

objectui#9791 (ruling C) · objectui#8167 (`conditionScope` table, director ruling 5716922008) · ADR-0088 · ADR-0089

Dedup terms: `EmbeddedItemEditor validation form`, `embedded validation rule raw JSON drawer`, `WidgetContext editAs validation`
